propositions: Capability decisions currently use provider-name string matching (startswith checks) instead of reading ModelProfile objects, causing silent failures for Bedrock-hosted Claude whose capabilities differ from direct Anthropic API
output_mode() and prompt-cache attachment both hardcode provider names in frozensets and startswith checks, missing Bedrock-hosted models and requiring a force_prompted boolean patch per call site

capabilities_for() must be a new leaf module in src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py (not providers.py) to keep providers.py under its attested 300-LOC acceptance criterion while separating capability interpretation from provider construction

capabilities_for() must accept both model objects (with .profile) and provider-qualified model strings (resolved via _PROFILE_RESOLVERS) to support S1's lazy-string path for optional SDKs like openai and google

The override table (_REBAR_OVERRIDES) must force native_structured_output=False for Claude on both direct Anthropic and Bedrock hosts to preserve PromptedOutput as the reliable path, replacing string matching with profile-type and field predicates

cache_settings_for() replaces _anthropic_cache_settings and dispatches on prompt_cache_style field to return the correct AnthropicModelSettings or BedrockModelSettings or None, enabling prompt caching for Bedrock-hosted Claude
